// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-source-pull: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export interface ConnectorPullReceipt {
    readonly receipt_id: string;
    readonly driver_id: string;
    readonly started_at: string;
    readonly completed_at: string;
    readonly result: ConnectorPollResult;
}

export interface ConnectorPullRequest {
    readonly slot_id: string;
    readonly integration_id: string;
    readonly record_key: string;
    readonly cursor: unknown;
    readonly intent?: {
        readonly sync_mode?: string;
    };
    readonly settings?: Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
}

export type ConnectorSignalDraft = ReturnType<RawEventAdapter["toSignalDraft"]>;

export declare const PLUGIN_EVIDENCE_READ_PERMISSION = "evidence:read";

export declare const PLUGIN_SOURCE_PULL_CONNECTOR_PERMISSION = "sources:pull_connector";

export declare const PLUGIN_SOURCE_PULL_FEED_PERMISSION = "sources:pull_feed";

export declare const PLUGIN_SOURCE_PULL_QUERY_PERMISSION = "sources:pull_query";

export declare const PLUGIN_SOURCE_PULL_REPOSITORY_PERMISSION = "sources:read_repository";

export interface PluginConnectorSourceClient {
    open(slot_id: string, integration_id: string): Promise<{
        readonly adapter: RawEventAdapter["adapter"];
    }>;
    pull(request: ConnectorPullRequest, options?: {
        readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
    }): Promise<ConnectorPullReceipt>;
    adapt(request: {
        readonly slot_id: string;
        readonly integration_id: string;
        readonly record_key: string;
        readonly event: ConnectorRawEvent;
    }): Promise<ConnectorSignalDraft>;
    accounts(service_ids: readonly string[]): Promise<Readonly<Record<string, {
        readonly bound: boolean;
    }>>>;
}

export interface PluginSourcePullClient {
    plan?(request: SourcePullRequest): Promise<{
        readonly intent_fingerprint: string;
    }>;
    pull?(request: SourcePullRequest, options: SourcePullOptions): Promise<SourcePullResult>;
    readonly evidence?: {
        read(content_ref: string): Promise<string | null>;
    };
    forget?(operation_ids: readonly string[]): Promise<{
        readonly records_deleted: number;
    }>;
    readonly vocabulary?: PluginSourceVocabulary;
    readonly repository?: {
        read(request: RepositoryReadRequest, options?: {
            readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
        }): Promise<RepositoryReadResult>;
    };
    readonly connector?: PluginConnectorSourceClient;
}

export interface PluginSourceVocabulary {
    readonly custom_rss_definition_id: string;
    readonly youtube_definition_id: string;
    readonly youtube_feed_host: string;
    catalog(): readonly SourceCatalogEntry[];
    normalizeCustomRssUrl(value: string): string;
    customRssHost(feed_url: string): string;
    normalizeYouTubeChannel(value: string): string;
    youTubeChannelFeedUrl(channel_id: string): string;
    isRssSourceKind(kind: string): boolean;
    rssFailureCount(cursor: unknown): number;
    rssCursorAfterFailure(cursor: unknown): {
        readonly cursor: unknown;
        readonly failures: number;
    };
    rssCursorAfterSuccess(cursor: unknown, receipt: RssFetchReceipt | null, completed_at: string): unknown;
}

export interface RepositoryEntry {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly summary: string;
    readonly body: string;
    readonly url: string;
    readonly published_at: string;
    readonly tags: readonly string[];
    readonly provenance: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
}

export interface RepositoryReadRequest {
    readonly repository: string;
    readonly source_id: string;
}

export interface RepositoryReadResult {
    readonly repository: string;
    readonly revision: string;
    readonly entries: readonly RepositoryEntry[];
}

export interface SourceCatalogEntry {
    readonly source_id: string;
    readonly name: string;
    readonly feed_url: string;
    readonly enabled: boolean;
    readonly category: string;
    readonly category_label: string;
    readonly limitations: readonly string[];
}

export type SourcePullKind = SourcePullRequest["kind"];

export interface SourcePullMaterial {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly candidate_id: string;
    readonly canonical_url: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly source_name: string;
    readonly published_at?: string;
    readonly preview: string;
    readonly content_ref: string;
    readonly content_hash: string;
    readonly content_type: string;
    readonly character_count: number;
    readonly captured_at: string;
    readonly provenance: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    readonly content_available: boolean;
}

export interface SourcePullOptions {
    hold(content_refs: readonly string[]): Promise<void>;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export type SourcePullRequest = (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "rss";
    readonly definition_id: string;
    readonly cursor?: unknown;
}) | (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "custom_rss";
    readonly feed_url: string;
    readonly cursor?: unknown;
}) | (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "youtube_channel";
    readonly channel_id: string;
    readonly cursor?: unknown;
}) | (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "web_query";
    readonly query: string;
});

export interface SourcePullResult {
    readonly operation_id: string;
    readonly intent_fingerprint: string;
    readonly outcome: string;
    readonly requirement_met: boolean;
    readonly materials: readonly SourcePullMaterial[];
    readonly receipts: readonly unknown[];
    readonly budget: unknown;
    readonly warnings: readonly string[];
    readonly http_receipt: RssFetchReceipt | null;
}

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

interface SourcePullBase {
    readonly operation_id: string;
    readonly source_name: string;
}
